sections.Profile:
"Golden Gloves" is a boxing-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams in 1960. Designed by Harry Mabs, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and a gobble hole, all set within a single-level playfield adorned with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Boxing, Single level playfield
